results.title: EXCLUSIVE: Trump approval falls to 33%, lowest of his presidency, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds

results.content:
## Polling averages update

All numbers are as of 10:30 AM Eastern on Sep. 4, 2026.

### 2026 U.S. House generic ballot

The Democratic margin in the 2026 U.S. House generic ballot remained stable this week, with Democrats ahead of Republicans by 6 percentage points. Currently, 49.7 percent of likely voters indicate that they plan to vote for a Democrat in November, while 43.7 percent plan to vote for a Republican.

results.title: The U.S. isn't that corrupt. Try telling voters that.

results.content:
Trump’s numbers heading into the 2026 midterm elections are lower than they were at the same point in his term in 2018, when they typically stood around 40 percent. They reached their highest point at the start of the pandemic, at 49 percent in April and May 2020, according to Gallup.

In the 2018 midterms, the GOP ended up losing the House majority, but it gained two seats in the Senate. [...] Polling conducted by Reuters/Ipsos released in mid-August 2018 found Trump’s approval rating was at 41 percent among all Americans, with 53 percent saying they disapproved. Eight years later and Trump’s approval, based on data from the same polling partners, is 8 points below that, at 33 percent.
